description: This file defines a singleton enum 'NodeServiceManager' that manages starting and stopping a node service via command-line commands, including parsing JSON responses, executing shell commands asynchronously, and logging outcomes.

classes.name: CommandResult
classes.description: Holds the result of executing a service command, including success status, payload data, message, and parsed JSON data.

classes.name: ParsedServiceJson
classes.description: Represents the JSON structure parsed from the service's response, containing status text, message, error details, and hints.

methods.name: serviceCommand
methods.description: Constructs the command array for invoking the node service with specified arguments.

methods.name: runServiceCommandResult
methods.description: Executes the constructed service command asynchronously, parses the output, and returns a CommandResult indicating success or failure.

methods.name: errorMessage
methods.description: Generates an error message based on the CommandResult, with special handling for 'not-loaded' state if specified.

methods.name: withJsonFlag
methods.description: Ensures the command arguments include the '--json' flag for JSON responses.

methods.name: parseServiceJson
methods.description: Parses a raw JSON string into a ParsedServiceJson object, extracting relevant fields.

methods.name: mergeHints
methods.description: Combines an error message and hints into a single string for better context.

methods.name: summarize
methods.description: Summarizes the last line of a given text for concise display.
